mapper.select: SELECT c.CASE_ID, c.MEMBER_ID, c.LAWYER_ID, c.TITLE, c.CASE_TYPE, c.DESCRIPTION, c.STEP, c.EXPERT_OPINION, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.CLOSED_AT, m.NAME AS clientName, lm.NAME AS lawyerName, r.RATING AS reviewRating, r.CONTENT AS reviewContent, TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY. MM. DD.') AS reviewDate FROM TB_CASE c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON c.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER lm ON l.MEMBER_ID = lm.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REVIEW_ID, MEMBER_ID, LAWYER_ID, RATING, CONTENT, CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY MEMBER_ID, LAWYER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC) as rn FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) r ON r.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID AND r.LAWYER_ID = c.LAWYER_ID AND r.rn = 1 WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} OR l.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC
